title: Repair and Deductible Charges in Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Hardship Assistance
content:
**Program terms.** On an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility account whose hardship approval is in force, charge-type points are added to the hardship assistance percentage according to the type of the charge being discounted, as shown on that patient charge:

| Type of the charge being discounted | Points added |
|---|---|
| repair patient share — an unplanned repair of equipment the patient owns | 4 |
| deductible | 2 |
| coinsurance or copay | 0 |

The points are percentage points added to the assistance percentage itself, which is applied once to the charge; they are not a separate discount.

**Cases (hypothetical).** A repair-patient-share charge for a repair to a patient-owned wheelchair adds 4 points. A deductible charge on a PAP rental month adds 2. A coinsurance charge adds none.
